claimBoundary: This file freezes the comparison protocol and inputs. It is not a result and carries no quality or promotion claim until a same-commit paired evidence file passes the executable audit.

arms.algi: Algi evidence retrieval plus deterministic compiler; zero model inference.
arms.scion: Current Scion base route plus the same compiler configuration.
arms.hybrid: Algi-admitted evidence ledger bound before one Scion grounded-authoring call, then the same compiler.

courses.prompt: User Experience Research Studio, exactly five lessons: 1) research questions and study planning, 2) contextual inquiry and field notes, 3) affinity mapping and synthesis, 4) usability test design, and 5) evidence-based design recommendations. Students produce a traceable research report.

Environmental Microbiology, exactly five lessons: 1) microbial ecology, 2) waterborne pathogens, 3) biofilms, 4) bioremediation, and 5) microbial risk assessment. Students use field evidence and state uncertainty.

Introduction to Quantum Computing, exactly five lessons: 1) qubits and quantum states, 2) superposition and measurement, 3) quantum gates and circuits, 4) entanglement, and 5) quantum error correction. Students compare classical and quantum representations without unsupported hardware claims.

Business Ethics and Responsible Decision-Making, exactly five lessons: 1) stakeholder analysis, 2) duties to workers, 3) conflicts of interest, 4) whistleblowing and retaliation, and 5) accountable case recommendations. Students justify decisions from explicit evidence.

World Literature and Comparative Reading, exactly five lessons: 1) world literature and circulation, 2) oral epic, 3) frame narratives, 4) translation and cultural mediation, and 5) comparative close reading. Students ground interpretations in assigned passages and name counter-readings.
